illness_away_active_ge1_on_production.classification_evidence: Close-graded look; per AGENTS.md's binding 'grade the decision at the opener' rule a close grade settles no play/no-play or terminal call regardless of sign, so unresolved_below_power is the only admissible classification here. Neither closing ground applies: no resolved wrong sign (the point estimate and both blockings favour the candidate) and no positive-control bound (the control detected +50.13 pts, proving the harness is not blind, but did not bound an effect of this size as absent).
illness_away_active_ge1_on_production.description: Away team active_illness_count >= 1 (injury-report illness designations excluding Out/Doubtful, resolved as of that game's own pick deadline) added as ONE feature column on top of the FULL production weak_stack/market_residual/ridge/alpha-10 chain, versus production unmodified. Paired candidate-minus-baseline forced-pick accuracy delta on the rotation-assigned [2011, 2013] block, close-graded. Predeclared docs/illness_on_production.md; ranked #1 of four in docs/on_production_sweep_20260901.md.
illness_away_active_ge1_on_production.notes: Window [2011, 2013], 746 paired games, 51 weeks, close-graded, mode=screen. Production weak_stack accuracy 49.866% vs weak_stack_illness_away 50.670%; paired delta +0.804 accuracy points. Week-blocked (primary, within-week correlation zero by owner mandate) 95% [-0.268, +1.914], P+ 0.908. Season-blocked secondary 95% [+0.398, +1.633], P+ 1.000 -- reported beside the week-blocked primary, never averaged with it, and read with the same caution docs/graph_team_stat_def_ypp_on_production.md gives its own: with only 3 season blocks the season bootstrap has very little combinatorial diversity, so its tight interval is a low-power artifact of block count, not a sharper answer. Within-week permutation null (200 draws, real feature, unleaked) centres +0.153 pts, sd 0.627; observed sits at the 82.5th percentile of its own null. Positive control (candidate column leaked to realized ats_margin) +50.134 pts, P+ 1.000, 95% [+46.428, +53.652] -- harness is not blind. Home-pick rate baseline 53.6% vs candidate 54.9%, close together, so little home-tilt artifact. Column coverage inside the window 100.0%, fires on 19.66% of games (151 of 768). NOT POOLABLE with the bare-baseline illness battery (illness_away_active_ge1, comparator is a bare market baseline, not the production chain) nor with fluview_elevated_on_production (CDC regional influenza-like-illness activity, a different underlying data source); AGENTS.md's commensurability rule forbids pooling across differing comparators and populations.
illness_away_active_ge1_on_production.plain_summary: At least one visiting player is on the injury report with an illness but still expected to play. Telling the model about it made its picks slightly better.
